text: We're about to push way more traffic through the API and webhooks — realistically 2 million events a month instead of the 100k we do now — and I need to know what that costs on the top tier. My developers already built the whole integration, so I can't afford a surprise bill that eats my margins alive. Can someone send me the rate limits and the real pricing?

On our trial, the REST API starts returning 429 errors after about 20 requests in a minute, but the API docs say the limit is 100 per minute. Our nightly job only does 300 calls total, so I'm not sure if something's wrong on our end or if trials just get a smaller allowance. If trials are capped, what plan would we need so the job can finish without timing out?

Please remove treasury@acmecorp.example from the marketing list that sent the quarterly analytics newsletter to our shared mailbox. The subscription arrived under our old vendor code LUM-77 but is not related to any active contract or open purchase order. We would prefer not to receive future promotional material while our renewal review under PO-95001 is underway.

We are considering a formal reseller partnership for Lumen in the Nordics and would like the partner program overview, referral terms, and API documentation for co-branded dashboards. Our commercial team sees this as separate from our own subscription, which is currently under PO-61555, but we need the materials before the partner summit on 12 June. Please direct the request to the appropriate partnerships contact.

We're trying to finalize our Enterprise contract before our fiscal quarter closes Friday to lock in the 15% discount your rep quoted us, but the paperwork with our procurement team at Northwind Labs keeps bouncing back. We're currently on monthly Team, billed per seat. Can someone from your side push this through today so we don't miss the window? The price genuinely goes up Monday, so this is time-sensitive for us. Thanks!

I think the SAML cert swap invalidated the API tokens your side issues. No jobs have run since, and it's cascading into the morning load. Need this working now.

One of them needs to be refunded today because it's the company card and the controller, Owen Barrett, is already asking about it. It also feels like the checkout page itself is broken, since it never gave me a receipt or a confirmation.

I've been testing Lumen for a week for an article on analytics pricing in TechLedger Monthly. The terminology tripped me up a bit at first, especially seats versus workspaces. For the piece, could someone confirm whether dashboards shared through a public link count toward a seat?

Please confirm whether this can be processed as a role correction or whether it requires a new plan order.

General note: the new dashboard builder is a big step up, much faster. One snag — when I duplicate a saved view, the filters don't copy over, so I rebuild them every time. No rush, just flagging since it bites me weekly. Everything else works great, keep it up.
